propositions: Hand-rolled argument parsing loops in claim.py and transition.py must be refactored to use Python stdlib argparse without changing observable behavior or flag semantics.
The --force flag must support optional reason argument (bare --force yields '(no reason given)', --force=<reason> yields that reason), and --reason must not be repurposed as the force note.
The --assignee flag must preserve None-vs-empty-string distinction: absent argument triggers default_assignee fallback, while explicit empty string clears the assignee.
Exit code 10 on ConcurrencyError and all existing CLI interface test behavior must be preserved unchanged.
Module size and per-function complexity ratchets must be respected by extracting refactored parser logic along existing call-graph seams rather than inflating single functions.
The refactor depends on blusterous-earthly-kitten semantic normalization and must adapt to the post-blusterous CLI surface without re-encoding soon-to-change flags.
